Our 10,000+ graduate students come from more than 100 countries—reflecting the global reach and strength of our academic programs and research. Admissions
How to Apply
International Applicants
International Graduate Applicants
Important steps before you apply
Find admissions requirements by program
Each department has its own graduate admission requirements, which are not determined or monitored by the Office of International Services (OIS). Visit the school website that offers your intended program for admission requirements and specific application instructions.
Review English proficiency requirements
IU Bloomington requires all international applicants to demonstrate English proficiency. Learn more about how to do this before applying.
Learn about visas and immigration status
Understand the different visa types and statuses for international students studying at IU Bloomington.
Review deadlines
Each graduate program determines its own application deadline and decides when it will accept applications. Visit your intended program’s website to find out when you need to apply.
Apply now
Be sure to choose the correct application based on your desired semester.
Apply for the Fall 2026 semester
If you are applying to the graduate school for the Fall 2026 semester, you will use this application.
Apply for 2027 and beyond
To apply for graduate school for the Winter 2026 through Fall 2027 semesters, you will use this application.
Prepare to apply
Explore your options
Not quite ready to apply? Take time to review academic programs and financial aid options to ensure you check all the right boxes during the application process.
Research majors
Discover our comprehensive list of master’s or Ph.D. degrees spanning various fields and disciplines. Use our filters to find programs that match your program type, interest areas, and preferred learning environment (online, hybrid, or in person).
Explore multidisciplinary programs
If you’re seeking a cross-disciplinary approach to your study, explore our multidisciplinary graduate programs. These programs transcend traditional academic boundaries, providing a unique and enriching educational experience.
Accelerated Master's Programs
Our Accelerated Master’s Programs (AMP) let you complete both a bachelor’s and master’s degree in just five years. This efficient path to advanced education saves you time while enhancing your career prospects.
Review loan options
Browse federal and private loan programs designed specifically to support graduate students and advanced study.
Explore other funding support
Search for grants and fellowships designed to help graduate students and postdocs find and secure the financial backing they need.
Review campus safety and security reports
Indiana University's annual security reports, which contain policy statements as well as crime and fire statistics for Indiana University campuses, are available online. You may also request a physical copy by emailing IU Public Safety at iups@iu.edu.
